Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic for tech/chips, driven by the extended U.S.-China trade truce. However, evolving AI narratives and competition within big tech are creating underlying currents.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are your most pressing concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and their deep drawdowns are amplified by your margin trading.

Watch: Keep an eye on further U.S.-China trade developments and how the AI narrative continues to shape the chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions while staying alert to macro tech drivers.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) to reduce margin risk, given their leveraged nature and significant drawdowns.
If looking to add to core tech, AAPL has a scanner BUY setup at entry 336.19-335.86 with a stop at 334.96, supported by the positive trade truce.
